questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of workplace boundaries?
options: To prevent employees from becoming friendly
To protect respectful, appropriate and professional interactions
To stop employees from helping one another

questions.prompt: A colleague repeatedly borrows your belongings without asking. What is the best response?
options: Communicate clearly that permission is required
Take the colleague's belongings in return

questions.prompt: A supervisor asks intrusive personal questions unrelated to work. What should an employee understand?
options: Supervisors are entitled to every personal detail
Employees must answer to demonstrate loyalty
Employees can maintain reasonable privacy boundaries

questions.prompt: A client requests an inappropriate sexual service. What should the therapist do?
options: Agree to avoid disappointing the client
Decline, maintain professional boundaries and follow reporting procedures
Ask a colleague to handle the request

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes healthy teamwork?
options: Supporting colleagues while respecting personal and professional boundaries
Always accepting additional duties regardless of circumstances
Sharing every personal detail with coworkers
